checkedAlternates.resolution: A tiebreak is a special 7-point deciding procedure at 6–6 (group-1), not a standard match unit (group-3).
Deuce and Advantage are post-40 tie-breaking game states (group-2), not the four base point calls 0/15/30/40 (group-4).
